title: Call write-up
summary: A written record of one call, with a note and follow-up tasks on the customer's record.
text: Write up the call with [who] from the notes in [call]. Follow the call write-up pack. Use the pack's parts as the headings, in its order: What they told us, Decisions, Who owns what, Deadlines, Risks, What they asked for, Open questions. Then add a short note and the follow-up tasks to that customer's record. Use only what the notes say, do not invent anything, and do not send anything to the customer.
